S1.membership_semantics: five stable recurring capacity slots; automation IDs and display names are mutable operational bindings and do not define slot identity or liveness
S1.enabled_state_authority: current ChatGPT scheduler state in the owning account

S2.membership_semantics: five stable recurring capacity slots; automation IDs and display names are mutable operational bindings and do not define slot identity or liveness
S2.enabled_state_authority: current ChatGPT scheduler state in the owning S2 account; worker reports are run-lifecycle start/finalization evidence only and do not prove current liveness, in-run progress, or scheduler flags

recurring_worker_partition_rule: S1 and S2 are independent canonical recurring partitions with exactly five stable capacity slots each (ten slots total). Slot bindings may change without changing topology. Activity in one partition never authorizes scheduler mutation in the other.

routine_recurring_recovery.peer_recovery: A recurring worker may perform one targeted idempotent is_enabled=true on an exact canonical same-partition sibling only after its own fresh report/start receipt, one bounded fleet-watch actionable candidate, and a corroborating live exact scheduler read of that disabled target. It must never mutate itself, cross partitions, or change prompt/title/schedule/timezone/stagger. Supervising/manual ChatGPT or explicit operator handoff remains the guarded fallback.
routine_recurring_recovery.scheduler_probe_requirement: REQUIRED_FOR_EVERY_SCHEDULER_MUTATION; verify exact target enabled state and last_run from ChatGPT scheduler before enable/rearm; local reports/history/Atlas alone never authorize scheduler mutation.
routine_recurring_recovery.topology_mutation_guard: Activity/topology in one partition is never scheduler-mutation authority for the other partition.

manual_workers.active_count_authority: live MCP/runtime evidence; manual current reports are purpose/freshness hints only
manual_workers.total_swarm_semantics: up to 5 recurring workers in S1 plus up to 5 recurring workers in S2, plus concurrently active manual/on-demand workers

handoff.note: S1 and S2 are both canonical recurring partitions; verify exact scheduler flags in the owning account. A current live scheduler run overrides stale local report evidence.

recurring_worker_total_semantics: slot capacity total; bound worker count may be lower while a slot is intentionally unbound during replacement

slot_binding_registry.semantics: slot identity is stable; automation_id and label are replaceable bindings; unbound or missing bindings are non-alert states and never scheduler-mutation authority
